In this part you learn to identify different sources of light  Using relevant pictures and realia, in the environment learners to identify sources of light. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify different sources of light  Using relevant pictures and realia, in the environment learners to identify sources of light.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model

Your turn
